CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

4. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   D. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

6. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Photography.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

10. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

11. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Netball.

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

13. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

14. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

15. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Percussion Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Netball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
